title: Assistant Resident Director, Summer Housing Summer Proctor
bio: Hello, all! My name is Brett. I am originally from South Dakota, and I am a former resident tutor for the Dudley Community at Harvard College. I work in the data science space as well as serve in the U.S. Coast Guard reserves as a corpsman. I am very excited to have you all be part of the summer housing community and to build friendships across campus :) Let's go!! Role Summer Proctors Summer Residential Directors
